samples: This program reads numbers from the command line and computes three statistical measures: the mean (average), median (middle value), and standard deviation (spread). It skips any non-numeric arguments and displays the results rounded to three decimal places, or reports "no data" if the input is empty. Use this if you need a simple command-line tool to quickly analyze a set of numerical values.
